name: Example: Acme Power customer service (a made-up line)
menu_rules: all of our representatives are busy|unable to take your call
to speak with a representative press 0|to speak to an agent press 0
menu_hints: Main menu: 1 outages, 2 billing, 3 start or stop service. Billing asks for the account number (key it in), then offers 0 for a representative at the end of its list. The outage line (1) is a recording and loops.
notes: Weekdays 7-7. Best time: right at 7:00. 'All representatives are busy' hangs up; redial every 10 minutes.
